images.prompt: A dramatic cinematic scene of Rust Global Warfare 4, showing two groups of armored players engaged in intense combat at sunset near a massive metal base. The Global Warfare 4 logo is subtly overlaid on the top left, and the scene captures the survival and strategy of the event.
